name: The Automaker
archetype: A vehicle assembler — body, paint, powertrain, final assembly, dealer network

ca.what: Vehicle safety — CMVSS compliance and the National Safety Mark, defect investigations and recalls under the Motor Vehicle Safety Act.
Vehicle and engine emissions standards, plus the plant's environmental compliance — air, effluent and hazardous waste.
Truth in advertising — fuel-economy and performance claims, pricing representations and consumer-protection compliance.

uk.what: In-service vehicle safety — safety-defect recalls, market surveillance and enforcement for vehicles already on the road.
Type approval of new vehicles and systems before sale — witness testing and conformity-of-production audits.
Environmental permitting of the plant — paint-shop VOC emissions, effluent discharge and waste handling.
Factory safety — machinery guarding, hazardous substances, RIDDOR incident reporting and enforcement.

roles.title: Board of Directors
roles.about: Elected by shareholders to govern the automaker. Sets strategy and capital allocation across plants and model programs, and holds the CEO to account. Works through its Audit, Compensation and Product Safety & Sustainability committees.
acc: Ultimate accountability for the safety of the product and the soundness of the company

Appointment, evaluation and succession of the CEO and senior officers
